records.label: Accordion
records.description: A coordinated set of expandable sections with shared state, focus and accessible relationships.

records.label: Account, plan and billing
records.description: Explain entitlement and payment state without relying on colour or provider-owned markup.

records.label: Actions and choices
records.description: Buttons and links use action-led wording and tell people what will happen before a consequential choice.

records.label: Adoption for content authors
records.description: Choose the context, write in the governed voice and use the owning catalogue or publication workflow for product, legal and translated meaning.

records.label: Adoption for designers
records.description: Trace the decision from principles and foundations to an owned semantic level and complete state matrix.

records.label: Adoption for developers
records.description: Import the supported owning package entry, preserve workflow contracts and validate every affected production-shaped Local journey.

records.label: Alternative text
records.description: Alternative text communicates an image's purpose in its context; surrounding text carries detail that belongs to everyone.

records.label: Analytics and explainable recommendation
records.description: Present scoped evidence and a reviewable next action without hiding uncertainty.

records.label: Approved vocabulary
records.description: Use the formal product identities and the DLS Element, Component, Widget, Pattern and Experience terms only for their governed meanings.

records.label: Australian English
records.description: English (Australia) is the first compiled locale and the writing baseline for source copy.

records.label: Authority before novelty
records.description: Start with the owning source, semantic level and supported state before creating a new visual value, API, phrase or local workaround.

records.label: Bidirectional and RTL layout
records.description: Direction comes from the locale contract; layout uses logical order while unknown-direction content is isolated.

records.label: Branding
records.description: Accepted master artwork and generated derivatives are the only implementation source for marks and formal lockups.

records.label: Button
records.description: Actions and action-styled navigation with one visual language and correct native semantics.

records.label: Card
records.description: A bounded surface that groups one related concept with optional header and content structure.

records.label: Change process
records.description: A focused Issue identifies authority, consumers, states, accessibility, provider limits and acceptance before an owning source changes.

records.label: Chart legend
records.description: A textual legend that connects governed series markers to data names and optional values.

records.label: Choice controls
records.description: Native checkbox and radio choices with integrated labels and optional descriptions.

records.label: Choreography
records.description: Coordinated movement may explain how multiple owned parts change together; it is not a licence for page-wide spectacle.

records.label: CMS content page
records.description: A visitor reads structured public content with meaning preserved when media is unavailable.

records.label: Colour
records.description: Approved brand colour enters products through semantic and component token roles, not copied palette values.

records.label: Components
records.description: Reusable interface building blocks, their APIs, states and composition guidance.

records.label: Confirmation and destructive action
records.description: Describe consequences before a destructive action and restore focus after dismissal.

records.label: Consumers
records.description: Generated review projections of externally owned catalogues.

records.label: Content
records.description: Voice, tone, vocabulary, language, grammar, alternative text and internationalisation.

records.label: Creator workspace
records.description: A creator reviews business signals, understands evidence and chooses a safe next action.

records.label: Data visualisation
records.description: Applications own the truthful chart and metric composition; governed data-series tokens and reusable legends support consistent presentation.

records.label: Decorative animation
records.description: Decorative movement is optional, restrained and removable; no core experience depends on it.

records.label: Dialog
records.description: A bounded modal interruption with trigger, focus management and restoration.

records.label: Disclosure
records.description: A native expandable region for optional supporting content.

records.label: Elements
records.description: The complete supported semantic HTML baseline before composed interface parts.

records.label: Empty and error states
records.description: Terminal content states that explain absence or failure and provide a next step.

records.label: Experience contexts
records.description: Public, authenticated product, operational, provider-constrained and communication surfaces share foundations but retain their owning workflow and risk meaning.

records.label: Experiences
records.description: Outcome-led journey compositions with responsive previews and implementation lineage.

records.label: Field
records.description: A semantic composition for a label, control, supporting description and validation error.

records.label: Form status
records.description: A live region for form-level progress, success, warning or error feedback.

records.label: Forms and authentication
records.description: Collect, explain and validate user input in a predictable reading and focus order.

records.label: Foundations
records.description: Branding, colour, typography, iconography, spacing and visualisation foundations.

records.label: Governance
records.description: Coverage, migration and source-lineage evidence that does not redefine runtime authority.

records.label: Grammar and case
records.description: Use sentence case, short active sentences and labels that describe the action or destination.

records.label: Guidelines
records.description: Accessibility, movement, naming and getting-started guidance: how to use the language.

records.label: Helper connection status
records.description: A creator can distinguish Sales Pulse and marketplace connection state and choose the owned recovery surface.

records.label: Iconography
records.description: There is no general-purpose icon library authority; approved brand marks and component-owned symbols are the bounded sources currently offered.

records.label: Icons, logos and chevrons
records.description: Visual symbols support a named action, state or identity; they do not replace accessible text or create an unapproved brand treatment.

records.label: Illustration
records.description: Approved visual direction favours simple, rounded, flat-colour supporting shapes; no general illustration library is offered.

records.label: Inclusive by default
records.description: Meaning survives different input methods, perception, language, direction, viewport, theme, motion preference and media availability.

records.label: Inclusive interaction
records.description: Every action has a persistent accessible name, usable input path, practical target and meaningful state relationship.

records.label: Interaction
records.description: Use native semantics and owned components for predictable input, state, validation and recovery behaviour.

records.label: Interaction feedback
records.description: Brief motion may confirm a direct action or changing state, but text and semantics carry the outcome.

records.label: International accessibility
records.description: Layouts and content tolerate language expansion, locale formatting, unfamiliar names and scripts without losing order or meaning.

records.label: Internationalisation
records.description: The runtime is multi-locale, while English (Australia) is currently the first compiled locale; do not imply translations that are not registered and complete.

records.label: Key-value list
records.description: A semantic description list for compact labelled values.

records.label: Loading
records.description: Explicit loading feedback and inert shape placeholders for delayed content.

records.label: Loading, empty and outcome flows
records.description: Explain what happened, what remains safe and the next recovery action.

records.label: Make the signal understandable
records.description: Experiences help people understand the information and next action without hype, pressure or hidden calculation.

records.label: Menu
records.description: A semantic list of navigation destinations.

records.label: Naming
records.description: Names communicate semantic level, user purpose and ownership instead of appearance or one implementation detail.

records.label: Navigation and header
records.description: Keep identity, location and high-value actions distinct across supported widths.

records.label: Notice
records.description: A prominent contextual message with optional heading and semantic tone.

records.label: One Creator Signal family
records.description: Sales Pulse is a product expression of Creator Signal and uses its approved identity through the governed asset and token contracts.

records.label: Pagination
records.description: Navigation between ordered pages of a larger result set.

records.label: Panel
records.description: An inset structural surface for dense or interactive page sections.

records.label: Patterns
records.description: Repeatable layout, messaging and interaction composition recipes.

records.label: Photography and creator work
records.description: Captions, credit, rights, privacy and alternative text are owned with the publication; the DLS supplies only the presentation and accessibility boundary.

records.label: Photography and product imagery
records.description: Use relevant, approved creator work where available and avoid generic stock imagery that obscures the product's designer focus.

records.label: Plan and billing recovery
records.description: A creator understands entitlement or payment failure and reaches the provider-owned recovery path without a false success claim.

records.label: Platform overview
records.description: An authorised operator can see service status and understand when an action is unavailable or unsafe.

records.label: Principles
records.description: Brand, experience vision and design principles: why the language exists.

records.label: Products
records.description: Application-owned workflow compositions and synthetic product reference states.

records.label: Provider-rendered message
records.description: A provider-rendered identity, lifecycle or billing message preserves essential meaning within supported configuration limits.

records.label: Public promise
records.description: A visitor understands the Creator Signal promise and can choose a clear next step.

records.label: Reduced motion
records.description: The shared motion preference removes non-essential animation and keeps every action, state and spatial relationship understandable.

records.label: Secure account entry
records.description: A person identifies their account, completes verification and can recover from an unavailable identity provider.

records.label: Select
records.description: A native single or multiple choice list with shared control presentation.

records.label: Sound
records.description: No Creator Signal sound language, audio asset library or notification-sonic contract is currently approved.

records.label: Spacing and sizing
records.description: The token source owns the spacing scale, content bounds and minimum control target; compositions use those roles logically.

records.label: Start here
records.description: Purpose, authority, vocabulary and audience routes into the system.

records.label: Stat
records.description: A grouped set of labelled headline values with optional context.

records.label: Statement import
records.description: A creator selects a statement, understands validation and reviews the import result without losing safe prior data.

records.label: Status labels
records.description: Compact labels and explicit indicators for metadata and operational state.

records.label: Status, errors and recovery
records.description: State what happened, what was affected and the next safe action without exposing sensitive implementation detail.

records.label: Switch
records.description: A native checkbox presented and announced as an immediate on/off setting.

records.label: Table
records.description: A semantic data table and labelled overflow region for narrow viewports.

records.label: Tabs
records.description: A coordinated keyboard-operable view switcher.

records.label: Text input
records.description: A single-line native input with shared control presentation.

records.label: Textarea
records.description: A multi-line native text control with shared presentation.

records.label: Theme and media behaviour
records.description: The shared theme runtime owns light, dark and system behaviour; constrained providers and email use bounded adapters.

records.label: Theme control
records.description: A coordinated system, light and dark appearance preference control.

records.label: Theme runtime
records.description: Non-visual React bindings for the governed theme runtime.

records.label: Token grammar
records.description: Primitive inputs express governed materials; semantic roles express purpose; component tokens narrow an owned API.

records.label: Tone by context
records.description: The same voice adjusts its level of warmth and precision to the consequence and audience of the moment.

records.label: Tooltip
records.description: Focusable supplemental explanation attached to a labelled trigger.

records.label: Transactional result message
records.description: A recipient understands the completed or failed event and retains an actionable fallback when images or styling are blocked.

records.label: Transitions
records.description: Transitions clarify continuity between related states or regions without delaying access to content.

records.label: Typography and fonts
records.description: The typography source owns self-hosted families, semantic roles and system fallbacks.

records.label: Visual accessibility
records.description: Contrast, focus, reflow, themes, forced colours and media fallbacks preserve meaning across visual conditions.

records.label: Voice
records.description: Creator-facing language is optimistic, encouraging, warm and useful, with confidence grounded in what the product actually knows.

records.label: Warm, never vague
records.description: Friendly language and playful visual moments support understanding; precision wins wherever consequence, risk or recovery matters.

records.label: Widgets
records.description: Interactive task units with behaviour, state and recovery guidance.

records.label: Current and planned
records.description: Planned items are synthetic design proposals, excluded from current runtime coverage. Promotion requires an owning implementation Issue and accepted runtime evidence; a merged preview does not change maturity.

records.label: Planned: Helper welcome and floating toolbar
records.description: First-use welcome overlay on Spoonflower with a movable toolbar, hide and restore, truthful activity and recovery states. No installed extension behavior, permission changes, provider actions or persistent preferences are implemented by this preview.

records.label: Planned: Helper installation welcome
records.description: Celebratory welcome tab after installation, with pinning, account connection guidance and an onward Spoonflower preview. Showcase only. No extension install event, account connection, permissions or persistent onboarding state is implemented.
